trial_court: Senior Civil Judge at Siruguppa and JMFC Court, Gangavathi (M.A.T.No.5/2016) / Senior Civil Judge and JMFC Court, Gangavathi (M.C.No.16/2017)
case_name: Mt. B. Gangamma W/O. B Ayyappa vs B. Ayyappa S/O. Late Mallayya

parties.petitioner_plaintiff: SMT. B. GANGAMMA W/O. B. AYYAPPA, housewife
parties.respondent_defendant: B. AYYAPPA S/O. LATE MALLAYYA, husband

facts_of_case: Petitioner-wife filed M.A.T.No.5/2016 seeking divorce, while respondent-husband filed M.C.No.16/2017 seeking restitution of conjugal rights; both cases pending in different courts

legal_principles.principle: In order to avoid the conflict of decisions, it is just and necessary that both the cases have to be heard and decided together by the Single Court.
legal_principles.held: These two cases are pending in two different Courts. If the said cases are decided independently, then there is a likelihood of conflict of decisions.
use_in: divorce cases with multiple pending suits

legal_principles.principle: The burden lies on the party seeking to avoid conflict of decisions to demonstrate that there is a likelihood of such conflict.
legal_principles.held: It is not in dispute that the respondent-husband has filed M.A.T.No.5/2016 seeking divorce and the petitioner-wife has filed M.C.No.16/2017 seeking restitution of conjugal rights.
use_in: divorce cases with multiple pending suits

outcome.final_order: Transfer the petition to the Court of Senior Civil Judge and JMFC, Gangavathi

use_for_drafting: advising on divorce proceedings in Hindu Marriage Act cases
assisting with notice service and response
